result_summary.title: Sandbox SSO sync delays and partial bulk import failures
result_summary.description: We are seeing significant synchronization delays in our EU-Central sandbox environment with the SSO Integration Module. Additionally, when we attempt to run bulk imports, they appear to partially fail without clear error logs. We are unsure if this is an issue with the SSO module itself or if the underlying identity storage is causing the bottleneck, as both seem involved in the process. This affects 2 users currently.

final_diagnosis.recommended_next_action: Verify the SSO Module configuration and check for any recent changes that may have caused the issue.
final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The SSO Module Issue and Identity Storage Bottleneck hypotheses are both active, with supporting evidence from various signals and changes. The issue category is likely related to Identity/Authentication, and the root cause may be a dependency failure. The affected component is the Group Sync Service, and the causal change is a data pipeline change. The owning team is the Identity team.
